action_items: Fix locale formatting crash by guarding Intl date formatting (avoid invalid locale tag en-US@posix path).
After crash fix, retest blocked flows: watchlist persistence, alerts max-5 behavior, chat two-session persistence, wallet error/escape, and full sidebar route sweep.
Confirm stale/fallback UI banner behavior under upstream throttling once frontend is stable.
critical_code_review_comments: Multiple components call toLocaleTimeString without locale fallback (e.g., MarketPrimitives DataStatus, EcosystemChat timestamps), which can throw on malformed environment locale and crash the app.
Global runtime failures are currently not isolated by an app-level error boundary, so one formatter exception breaks entire route workflows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is ready and passing at /app/backend/tests/test_market_chat_api.py. Frontend scripts reproduced a global runtime crash ('Invalid language tag: en-US@posix') across multiple runs; this blocks deeper UI verification. Start next run by validating the locale crash fix, then resume full route/chat/watchlist/alerts checks.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /terminal, interact with market/chat/sidebar routes; overlay appears with 'Invalid language tag: en-US@posix'. Console repeatedly logs PAGE ERROR with same message. Likely source is Date.toLocaleTimeString usage with environment-provided invalid locale. Mitigation: enforce safe locale fallback (e.g., undefined->'en-US' fallback via try/catch utility), and centralize formatter usage across UI components.
